label: Every first mover moved by none is PURE_ACT_5, from first in being and a PRIOR_4 bridge
description: Under adopted POTENCY_1 (InPotency x r := CanBe x r ∧ ¬ InAct x r): let f be a first mover moved by none. It is first in being (PRIOR_4); the bridge makes it first in PRIOR_1. If f were in POTENCY_1 in some respect r, act's simple priority (a4d3261a) would give a y in act in r that is PRIOR_1 to f, so y = f, and f would be both in act and not in act in r. So f is PURE_ACT_5 (in POTENCY_1 in no respect). It composes the existing theorem firstMoverPureAct (result of argument 3e2366b5) with non-overlap discharged by the adopted sense (AdoptedPotency.nonOverlapByConservativeAnalysis), so c6d6379b, which carries POTENCY_2, is not a premise. The only passage from PRIOR_4 to PRIOR_1 is the listed bridge. Argument 3e2366b5 itself is unchanged and uses PRIOR_1 alone. Given c51a07a1 the bridge is equivalent to the content of 74eb9113, so this route gives no new warrant for PRIOR_1-firstness; its gain is sense hygiene: the 47aff057 equivocation (through 70e98bb5 in f8992ef7) leaves this support, and c6d6379b (POTENCY_2) is discharged by adopted POTENCY_1. The bridge is sufficient, not weakest: a respect-matched weaker variant also suffices (checked control pureActOfRespectMatchedBridge).
